description: This file defines the Currency controller class within the OpenCart admin module, responsible for managing currency-related tasks such as listing, generating, and clearing currency data files.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: Controller class for managing currency tasks in the OpenCart admin area, including generating currency lists, clearing cache files, and managing task scheduling.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes currency tasks by creating a main task and generating subtasks for each store and language, organizing currency data update tasks.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Generates a JSON file with currency data for a specified store and language, returning success or error messages.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes generated currency JSON files for all stores and languages.
